This discrepancy, combined with the introduction of 6 bugs and a low code quality score of 70, indicates a high likelihood of deception. The extreme pressure and ambitious nature of the developer, along with the major exaggeration strategy, further support the suspicion. The manager's message, while acknowledging challenges, does not align with the reported progress, adding to the suspicion. The high stress index and low honesty score also contribute to the overall high suspicion score.
